reviews.title: Defective Sticks
reviews.comment: I bought the parts and waited until I had all of my pieces to put the PC together. Upon doing so, I seated both ram sticks properly, in 1 & 2, then 2 & 4, and then I tried one ram stick and then the other to see if that was the issue, but nothing I did would work. The motherboard itself lights up with an error saying they do not work. Sadly, due to the fact that I waited until the return policy had passed, I can not get a refund for defective sticks.
